g.text: Contextual benchmark on identical development origins
22 fixed market-year/horizon cells; seed scores averaged before equal-cell ratios. Negative values favor the named method.
The two panels use different reference forecasts. Representations, horizon coupling, location freedom and total parameter counts differ across families.
This is a descriptive system comparison, not an isolated architecture effect or a reproduction of original paper leaderboards.
